nodes.name: mouse.cpp
nodes.summary: Processes Win32 mouse messages into button, wheel, client, and backbuffer coordinates plus per-frame movement deltas.

nodes.name: billboard.cpp
nodes.summary: D3D11 camera-facing and ground-aligned quad batcher: loads CSO shaders, sorts by depth, and draws the registered billboard list.

nodes.name: billboard.h
nodes.summary: Static Billboard API and BillboardData layout for queued world-space sprites with UV, rotation, and ground-align flags.

nodes.name: post_process.cpp
nodes.summary: Fullscreen post-process pass that composites stackable effects from the offscreen PostRT onto the back buffer, including timed RGB-shift bursts.

nodes.name: post_process.h
nodes.summary: Declares PostFXParams and the initialize, update, burst, and draw API for the fullscreen post-process stack.

nodes.name: renderer.cpp
nodes.summary: Owns the D3D11 device, swap chain, depth buffer, and offscreen PostRT, plus resize, window-mode, viewport, and present.
nodes.languageNotes: PostRT is an offscreen color target matching the swap chain so post-process can sample the scene before presenting.

nodes.name: renderer.h
nodes.summary: Public D3D11 renderer surface: device accessors, MATERIAL/VERTEX_3D layouts, viewport helpers, and PostRT bind/resize entry points.

nodes.name: shader.cpp
nodes.summary: Loads compiled 2D/3D shaders and uploads WVP, skin palette, material, surface-FX, and cascade-shadow constant buffers.
nodes.languageNotes: Shader3D variants are selected by id and bind different pixel CSOs; skin and surface-FX use dedicated constant-buffer slots.

nodes.name: effect_system.cpp
nodes.summary: Wraps Effekseer DX11: manager setup, cached effect loading, playback handles, and 3D draw using the current camera matrices.

nodes.name: effect_system.h
nodes.summary: EffectSystem namespace API for loading, playing, transforming, and drawing Effekseer particle effects.

nodes.name: Mouse_Initialize
nodes.summary: Stores the window handle and seeds client coordinates from the current cursor position.

nodes.name: Mouse_ProcessMessage
nodes.summary: Handles WM mouse move, button, and wheel messages, accumulating deltas and updating button/wheel state.

nodes.name: Mouse_GetDelta
nodes.summary: Returns this frame movement as normalized backbuffer-space deltas using client-to-buffer scale.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Loads billboard VS/PS CSO files and creates the unit-quad VB, constant buffers, sampler, and raster/depth states.

nodes.name: Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases static D3D11 billboard resources and clears the pending draw list.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Extracts camera right/up from the view matrix and depth-sorts queued billboards back-to-front.

nodes.name: Draw
nodes.summary: Binds the billboard pipeline and draws each queued sprite with per-instance position, UV, and alignment constants.

nodes.name: Add
nodes.summary: Queues a billboard with explicit UV offset/scale, or the simpler overloads that default those fields.

nodes.name: LoadShaderFile
nodes.summary: Reads a compiled shader CSO from disk into a byte vector for CreateVertexShader/CreatePixelShader.

nodes.name: PostProcess_Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the fullscreen post-process VS/PS, constant buffer, and linear sampler from compiled CSO files.

nodes.name: PostProcess_Shutdown
nodes.summary: Releases post-process shaders, constant buffer, and sampler state.

nodes.name: PostProcess_SetEffects
nodes.summary: Stores the full PostFXParams stack (shift, mosaic, posterize, noise, and related knobs) as the base effect state.

nodes.name: PostProcess_GetEffects
nodes.summary: Copies the current base PostFXParams out for editor or gameplay inspection.

nodes.name: PostProcess_Update
nodes.summary: Advances the timed RGB-shift burst and decays it back toward the base effect values.

nodes.name: PostProcess_Draw
nodes.summary: Samples PostRT and draws a viewport-fitted fullscreen triangle onto the back buffer with the current effect CB.

nodes.name: CreateDepthBuffer
nodes.summary: Creates the D24S8 depth-stencil texture and view for the current back-buffer size.

nodes.name: CreateRenderTargetFromSwapChain
nodes.summary: Obtains the swap-chain back buffer and creates its render-target view.

nodes.name: PostRT_Resize
nodes.summary: Recreates the offscreen post-process color target, RTV, and SRV to match the requested size.

nodes.name: Renderer_BindPostTarget
nodes.summary: Binds PostRT plus depth as the OM target and clears both using current render settings.

nodes.name: ReadClientSize
nodes.summary: Reads the HWND client rectangle into cached width/height, rejecting degenerate sizes.

nodes.name: Renderer_ClientToBackbuffer
nodes.summary: Maps client-pixel coordinates onto back-buffer space using the client-to-buffer scale.

nodes.name: Renderer_BackbufferToClient
nodes.summary: Inverse-maps back-buffer coordinates back into client-pixel space.

nodes.name: Renderer_UpdateClientSize
nodes.summary: Refreshes cached client dimensions from the window and reports whether they changed.

nodes.name: Renderer_ResizeBuffers
nodes.summary: Resizes the swap chain, rebuilds RTV/depth/PostRT, and restores the default viewport.

nodes.name: Renderer_ResizeToClient
nodes.summary: Resizes GPU buffers when the client size no longer matches the back buffer.

nodes.name: Renderer_SetWindowMode
nodes.summary: Toggles windowed versus borderless/fullscreen by updating styles, placement, and swap-chain buffers.

nodes.name: SetRenderViewport
nodes.summary: Applies a sub-rectangle RS viewport used by the game view inside the editor chrome.

nodes.name: InitRenderer
nodes.summary: Creates the D3D11 device, swap chain, rasterizer/depth/blend states, and initial back-buffer targets.

nodes.name: UninitRenderer
nodes.summary: Releases device, swap chain, state objects, and offscreen PostRT resources.

nodes.name: UpdateShadowCB
nodes.summary: Uploads cascade light-view-projection matrices, bias, and split distances to the shadow constant buffer.

nodes.name: Shader_Initialize
nodes.summary: Loads 2D/3D vertex and pixel CSOs, creates input layouts, and allocates WVP, skin, material, FX, and shadow CBs.

nodes.name: Shader_Finalize
nodes.summary: Releases all shader objects and constant buffers created during Shader_Initialize.

nodes.name: Shader_SetProjectionMatrix
nodes.summary: Caches the projection matrix and dirties 2D/3D VP constant buffers when the value changes.

nodes.name: Shader_SetViewMatrix
nodes.summary: Caches the view matrix and dirties VP constant buffers when the camera view changes.

nodes.name: Shader_SetSkinPalette
nodes.summary: Uploads the GPU skin-bone palette and enabled/count flags used by the skinned 3D vertex shader.

nodes.name: Shader_CommitSurfaceFX
nodes.summary: Packs scrolling/fresnel surface-FX parameters plus SystemTimer time into PS slot 4.

nodes.name: Shader_BindShadowMaps
nodes.summary: Binds an array of cascade shadow SRVs to the 3D pixel-shader shadow slots.

nodes.name: Shader3D_Begin
nodes.summary: Binds the requested 3D shader variant, updates WVP/material/shadow CBs, and sets IA topology.

nodes.name: Shader3D_BeginOutline
nodes.summary: Binds the outline 3D shader path used for toon/silhouette passes.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the Effekseer DX11 graphics device, renderer, and manager, then wires sprite/model/material loaders.

nodes.name: Draw3D
nodes.summary: Builds Effekseer view/projection from the active camera and draws all playing 3D effects.

nodes.name: LoadCached
nodes.summary: Loads an .efk effect from a wide path, caching the manager effect id for reuse.
